11.t: Working with data: a noise survey
q: Which place was loudest at 7 am?
Calculate the change at the school gate from 7 am to 10 pm.
Suggest why the school gate is loud at 7 am.
Traffic and parents dropping students off.
Evaluate whether one reading at each time is enough for a conclusion.
Not enough: noise varies minute by minute; take several readings and a mean, on several days, with the same meter.
